summary:
Plan of w104 (design-model-check r27, r106, r111) is in .shop/scratch/2-plan/plan.md.
Code: read_part in model_work.py writes an accepts fact for every resolved accept, using the requirement id when no scenario names it (r106). It adds the file problem only for a work-item that is not withdrawn, on a capability that is not guarantees, and not for a retired id accepted while green (r27). In model.lp, w_unserved_cap is guarded on a job node (r111).
The researcher's questions are settled: the guard is on job nodes, and the narrator sees no difference today because no job is read. D5 keeps today's file problem, since r24 does not cover accepts. test_check_ends_with_the_four_counts keeps its line and gains an uncited observation in its setup.
Tests: new Given steps in given.py; new Then steps ('does not give w_unserved_cap', 'prints no file problem naming') in then.py, which is added to the set because problems.py has 11 lines of room; a two-line malformed_work branch in problems.py; a FIELDS key in one_each.py.
Open cases: pytest --work-item refuses a work-item whose accepts no scenario names; the brief has no scenario line for such accepts; ranges on guarantees capabilities.
